kind: single originally accounted async snapshot upload port; no persisted schema
accounting: full original source/upload identity and exact binding_digest retained before each independent mutation reservation; metadata allowance supplies no data allowance
invocation: one exact management receiver/routing target/method/Candid host replicated update; no batching, query/proxy substitution, implicit funding, hidden retries or observations
admission: integration-owned authentic complete source, fresh actual context/controllers/prerequisites, exclusive new destination attribution for data, stable bytes/command custody and proof of no prior dispatch
reply: bounded passive actual claims and exact raw bytes; explicit association rechecks current original journal and tighter method-specific wire bounds; no authenticated outcome
failure: all variants/drop/death retain consumed pending mutation, originals, source references, obligations and recovery evidence; no receipt, retry or refund
replay: local retained replay invokes no provider; reconstructed pending attempts grant no redispatch
qualification: Actual Agent simulator metadata/data uploads use the configured adapter and single-upload coordinator. The Testkit fixture separately exercises allocation and complete data-stage loops. Cancellation tests retain original spending, exact replies, earlier receipts and unchanged source evidence; local HTTP cases prove zero/one submission and signed body equality, not management effects.
grants: no default provider, full runner, fresh permission, automatic outcome, complete upload, load/start safety, terminal proof or fence/reference release
unchanged: existing v1 records, codecs, digests, bounds, exhaustive enums, dependencies, allowances, package version and release receipt
async_contract: Providers return futures and recheck the currently guarded original journal. Await upload/allocation/data-stage coordinators with async admission/qualification under selected exclusion; retain replies before cancellable qualification. Cancellation preserves source, earlier receipts and pending spending and denies reentry. No runtime or Send bound follows.
configured_adapter: ic-backup-agent::AgentSnapshotUploadProvider requires explicit configured transport and mandatory durable exact signed-envelope/request-ID retention before one source-bound update. No default retainer or application lane.
